audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeatedly names Hwei's key CC ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no ability by that name anywhere in his kit (P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair). This is a fabricated ability name, the same class of error flagged in the calibration notes (Brand's 'Ares of Blaze', Cassiopeia's 'Noxious Blight').
audit.why: Hwei's real CC ability is E, Subject: Torment (cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s), whose sub-spells are Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw per Riot's kit text — all his hard CC lives there. The fabricated name appears in winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, feeding, loading, focus.text, two dosFull bullets, and two report entries.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with the real ability, Subject: Torment (E), in every field editable within scope (winCon, enemyWin, cooldowns, feeding, loading, focus.text, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, and the two report entries permitted by the report-entry cap).

audit.why: Content layer (early/mid/late/whys) already grounds this as a poke lane Hwei wins with real ability shorthand (QQ, EE, QE, QW, EW) — matches the 52.08% Hwei-leaning win rate and TRICKY diff.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[].side is 'Skill' on all seven rows even though content win[] and the packet levelChart both give Hwei all seven stages.
audit.why: Chart rule: phases[N].side must name the same side as content win[N]. Content's own detailed prose (his QQ/EE out-range Maokai at 1, QE root punishes the level-2 W all-in, R+QW out-zones the level-6 ult) already grounds a clean Hwei-favored read, so the flat 'Skill' template disagrees with the page's own text.
audit.corrected: Moved side to Hwei on all seven rows with why rewritten to match content's grounded reasoning.
